question: In hockey, what is the meaning if the umpire signals by pointing both arms horizontally toward the centre of the field?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goal scored**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• If the umpire signals by pointing both arms horizontally toward the centre of the field it means **goal scored**.
 
• If the umpire raises both arms horizontally in the direction of the goal, it is a penalty corner of the signal.
